That sounds about right. My case was about as severe as is possible. I don't mind talking about it.

I had (according to my eye doctors) the most severe case of Myelinated Retinal Nerve Fiber layers he (or anyone else) had ever seen. He even asked if he could use a special 360 degree panoramic camera to photo it for his "Interesting Case of the month." Basically, the nerve fibers that connect to the optic nerve that pass along the sight information were frayed and never really connected to the optic nerve. My eyesight in that eye was down to only being able to see peripheral movement and light/dark changes. Anything past the 35 degree angle from the peripheral was completely blank. (Think of a clock. If you can see from 9 to 12 in left eye, and 12 to 3 in the right, I could only see from 9-10 and 12-3. Anything from 10-12 was just a "hole" in my vision.)

That was me for 35 years. Then I started getting these really bad headaches, and no one could figure out why. 5 years later, they were so bad I finally went to the emergency room, and found out that I had a severe case of neovascular glaucoma. This type of glaucoma is where the eye creates too many blood vessels in the retina (basically creating a new retinal wall), and both reducing the area inside the eye for fluid and blocking the internal drainage system that regulates the pressure. Glaucoma is a CONDISHUN where your eye has too high of pressure. A typical, treatable case is around 2x normal pressure or less. 4x normal becomes dangerous and usually leads to blindness. Mine was 9x normal. They drained it using a needle that day, and then I had 3-4 laser surgeries to reduce the retinal wall and to remove 75% of the cells that create fluids. After 3 years of rounds of surgeries and treatments, plus these nasty pills, my eye started to bleed as the blood vessels kept growing and started popping. The headaches returned with a vengeance.

I laid in bed for 12 days. No sleep. No eat. My head felt like it was going to explode. Never had that much pain before. I had 2 cans of ginger ale and about 2/3rds a sleeve of Ritz crackers in 12 days. (Cue STARVASHUN MODE!!! Yep, I lost 22 lbs, but mostly muscle. BOO. Surprisingly, I didn't become hugely fat by not eating. Who could have predicted that??? Must have been MUH JENETIX) On day 13, they removed the eye completely. I got a prosthesis about 2 months later and lived happily ever after.

The End. .~)
